notes.title: First Day Corrections
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41155218/9fe87d2f2b31b0664e6ddabfbbe13edfda3315cb.png[/img]

Small fixes and new items, achievements, puzzles.

- Fixed a bug with the door, now it does not open by itself
- New riddles added
- Added new achievements and fixed old ones.
- Slightly changed the island
- Fixed ending credits
- Fixed first intro
- Controller pictures have been corrected

That's all for now, see you in new updates!

tags.feature: - New riddles added
- Added new achievements and fixed old ones.

notes.title: Eighth update (0.4)
notes.content:
In the new major update SICK 0.4

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41155218/d19934aaa30dca1d1be204cf6e0ab29f5650df2f.png[/img]

- The map has increased by 1.5 times.
- Added languages ​​such as Spanish, Russian, German, Turkish, Slovak, Polish.
- Fixed a bug when a character walked through trees.
- Locations have been greatly changed, new buildings have been added, paths have been changed, etc.
- More items to look at and interact with.
- Now the character can get tired while running.
- Fixed mirrors, now they show correct reflections.
- Optimized camera distance, now objects do not disappear.
- An NPC has appeared in the game, I think you will make friends :)
- Added dialog system.
- There is a special button (in the menu) and a design for the New Year.
- The pause interface and its internal options have been slightly changed.

(I apologize in advance for the incomplete translation, as in the near future I will be working on all the worked out levels).
Also, you won't have to wait long for the next updates 0.4.1 and 0.4.2.

Added secrets :)

Also a small surprise - a discount of as much as 75%.

notes.title: Fifth update (0.3)
notes.content:
In the new major update SICK 0.3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41155218/4aaa161b6273482181229d3ba679b06a5d98a9ca.png[/img]


- Added newer animations.
- Sounds changed.
- Locations have been changed.
- Added ladders.
- Added the ability to save the game and load the save.
- Now, when playing at minimum settings, there are even more fps.
- Fixed a bug with fans on the ceiling, now they are spinning and not standing still.
- Changed the music in the main menu.
- Now the levers are also highlighted.
- Fixed collision of walls, now there are no holes.
- Added a passage to the backyard of the house.

notes.title: Third update (0.2.1)
notes.content:
New update in SICK version 0.2.1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41155218/022d4abb532171bf83f3856d056517a7c9655880.png[/img]

- After reading the reviews on the game, I came to the conclusion that the keys are very difficult to find, now, to facilitate the task, they will be outlined with a white outline so that their scatter is noticeable

- Now the bug with the keys has been completely fixed, the accidental opening of the door has been fixed.

That's all for now, I wish you a good game and I hope you enjoyed this new update :)
